snippet.title: Hold the Mine - Early Access Out Now
snippet.description:
In Hold the Mine, explore a long-forgotten mine, gather precious resources, and build powerful structures that synergize with the heroes you unleash along the way. As night falls, defend your mine against relentless waves of monsters.

Play now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3164960/
